# Euno

Euno is a Data Infrastructure and Analytics company. Euno is an AI context platform for enterprise data that allows agents to turn their metadata into automated, trusted context for AI. Euno employs 34 people (+54.5% YoY, +12 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across Israel, United States, France, and Netherlands.

## About

Euno’s AI context platform continuously learns how organizations build, use, and govern their data, giving AI agents the organizational intelligence they need to navigate enterprise data and act reliably. Acting as the AI brain behind enterprise data, Euno enables Fortune 500 customers to move a wide range of AI initiatives from pilot to production in weeks.

# Euno

Euno is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Euno is the world’s first global rewards marketplace, connecting customers with the brands and rewards that they love, and transforming everyday moments into memorable experiences. Euno employs 4 people. Its workforce is distributed across Australia, Malta, Singapore, and United Kingdom.

## About

The Future of Rewards.

Euno is the world’s first global rewards marketplace platform, giving businesses a smarter and more flexible way to engage and reward their customers, whilst instantly monetising their customer base and unlocking new revenue streams. 

Unlike traditional loyalty models that limit both businesses and their customers, Euno enables seamless earning and redemption across brands, industries and regions to become a truly fluid and interconnected rewards solution - always on and always relevant. 

Customers expect more choice, more freedom and more value from their rewards. Euno provides the ideal platform for businesses to not only meet but exceed these expectations, enabling them to offer their customers rewards that they actually want and will use, whilst driving higher engagement, increased spending and stronger brand loyalty.

Euno services global and national brands, their ancillary partners and localised SMEs across a broad range of lifestyle sectors including but not limited to travel, retail, hospitality and entertainment, providing a singular rewards network that benefits everybody. 

Please follow along here for updates, visit the website www.euno.global and reach out to a member of our team today to learn how Euno can work for your business.
